thread:
sarah (CSM): Heads up — Skylark QBR prep. I noticed a big jump in token spend this month, want to triage before Friday.
mike (Account Lead): ok, can you share numbers?
jordan (Finance): Last 30d: 12.5M tokens (gen + embeds). If current growth continues, forecast ~45M next quarter. Estimated cost at current plan ~= $13k/month — ~40% above their committed runway.
sarah (CSM): that matches what I saw. Their data team started a heavy embedding job for search last week.
lee (Eng): quick options: 1) reduce embedding dim for non-critical indices, 2) enable prefix/KV caching on Dedicated, 3) route low-priority traffic to gpt-embed-lite variant. I can push config changes in <24h.
mike (Account Lead): which is the lowest-friction thing we can demo in the QBR as an immediate savings lever?
lee (Eng): routing + caching. I can deploy a canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with auto-rollback on quality/latency regressions. We'll capture token delta metrics.
katie (Enablement): I'll run a 30-min enablement session with their data engs to show sampling, prompt trimming, and embedding dim tradeoffs. Wed 10am PT works for me.
sarah (CSM): jordan, please prepare a revised forecast slide: baseline vs post-optimizations. Show projected $/1M tokens after routing to lite model and enabling cache.
jordan (Finance): will do. Need assumptions: lite model reduces tokens per embed by 30% and costs $50 per 1M tokens vs $120 for standard — are those reasonable?
lee (Eng): ballpark matches our internal perf tests. I'll run a small experiment and post results here.
sarah (CSM): also request: set budget-alert automation so we don't miss the next spike. @deploy-bot can you paste recent alerts and confirm webhook to the customer's Slack channel?
deploy-bot: recent alerts for account skylark:
- 2026-03-02T15:42:10Z threshold: $4,000/day (triggered) — avg request length increased
- 2026-03-04T09:12:03Z threshold: $4,500/day (escalated) — embedding batch size increased
Webhook to #skylark-ops: configured = true
mike (Account Lead): can we add a temporary quota on embeddings until the optimization rollout completes? want to avoid another big spike.
lee (Eng): yes. Sample Console API call to set quota:
```
POST /v1/accounts/skylark/alerts
{ "type": "quota", "resource": "embeddings", "limit_per_day": 500000 }
```
I'll apply a canary quota (10% of traffic) now and monitor.
katie (Enablement): for the QBR deck I'll prepare a one-pager playbook: "Immediate savings (0-7 days)" and "Medium term (7-30 days)" so AE/CSM can run it with the customer.
jordan (Finance): adding three scenarios to the deck: base, route+cache, route+cache+dim-reduction with token and $ estimates + variance bands.
sarah (CSM): action items: mike schedule QBR (Thu or Fri), katie run enablement Wed 10am PT, lee start canary routing + quota + post experiment numbers, jordan update forecast slide. I'll compile the deck and send a draft before EOD Wed. Any objections?
mike (Account Lead): none. go ahead.
lee (Eng): starting canary now, posting quick logs:
```
[canary] route=lite v=0.1 status=started ts=1764520200
[canary] observed -22% tokens per embed in first 2k calls
```
sarah (CSM): great — thanks. I'll follow up with the deck link and the QBR invite.
katie (Enablement): noted. I'll bring a short script the customer can run to validate quality tradeoffs during the enablement.
jordan (Finance): draft slides ready, will fold in lee's numbers when experiment finishes.
mike (Account Lead): final ask for the deck: include a rollback/auto-fallback line (auto-fallback to standard model on quality regression). lee, can you paste that policy snippet?
lee (Eng): will paste fallback policy in 15m.
sarah (CSM): thanks team — let's aim to close canary results and the deck by Wed EOD so QBR is tidy on Thu.
